visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot focuses on a hand with gold-toned jewelry holding a smartphone. The screen displays the Spotify music player with a song titled 'HOME SWEET HOME' by TAEYANG. The background is a blurry gray tile floor. (2) The camera cuts to a girl with short dark hair and hair clips, wearing a white off-the-shoulder knit top. She is in a studio setting with professional lighting equipment, including a softbox and a stand, visible behind her. She smiles, gestures with her hands, and turns her head while speaking toward the person behind the camera. (3) A screen recording sequence begins, demonstrating the Spotify interface. A thumb interacts with the 'Jam' feature, navigating through menus to 'Join' a session and sharing a link via a messaging app. The background of the recording shifts through various playlist icons and settings. (4) The girl is seen sitting on an orange couch in the studio, holding the phone. The scene abruptly transitions into a high-energy dance sequence in a darkened room. Vibrant, flashing neon pink and green light beams crisscross the frame as the girl shakes her head and moves her body rhythmically, her hair flying wildly. (5) A final close-up shows the girl laughing and then suddenly grimacing with her eyes closed and mouth open in a comedic 'ouch' expression, as if she just bumped into a piece of furniture, with variety text appearing over the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Educational Demonstration -> Sensory Climax -> Comedic Twist
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Spotify's 'Jam' feature by explaining its collaborative functionality through a relatable dialogue between friends, transitioning from a clear tutorial to a humorous, high-energy demonstration of 'becoming a DJ' that ends with a physical comedy mishap.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and demonstrates the Spotify Jam feature and shows the app interface throughout.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a mix of practical screen recording and live-action comedic acting to maintain high engagement while delivering technical information. The contrast between the clean studio lighting and the chaotic neon dance scene serves as a strong visual hook.
